readout.primary: ( r(x0) + (w - kappa(x0|U_P))^T r(U_P) ) / (1-gamma) -- part's (17b) eq. with prototypes->pool; exactly linear in r
readout.secondary: ( r(x0) + (mu-mu0)^T w_r ) / (1-gamma), mu=w^T B(U~P), mu0=kappa(x0)^T B(U~P), w_r=ridge fit of r on B(U~P) -- the compact-reward-code repair; linear in r for a fixed pool/ridge but not a bare dot product (see script docstring)
readout.w: softmax_j(F(s,a,g).B(u_j)/temp) per F-head, elementwise min over the 2 heads if double_q (spec sec.3)
readout.kappa: GCIQLFlowAgent._delta_phi(x0, U_raw, blocks) -- SAME code path training uses, evaluated at the CURRENT state (not successor)
readout.decode: retrieval only (spec-14-comparable): ONE goal-proxy observation g_hat decoded per family/task via this readout's own PRIMARY score, then a plain fixed-goal rollout, no per-step re-scoring (qr_greedy not implemented -- see module docstring 'SCOPE NARROWING')
readout.pool_sweep: prefix+renormalize of ONE P_max forward pass (exact, no re-draws) -- t=0 PRIMARY Q-estimate drift only, NOT full rollout success-rate stability unless --pool_sweep_full_rollout was passed

decode.x0_source: canonical seed-0 env reset (main()'s per-task/region pool env)
decode.action_fed: trained flow actor's one-shot deterministic proposal a_j ~ actor(x0, g_j), temperature=0, single shared rng key across all candidates
